question_text: Was the Ochsner Health data breach a cyberattack?
answer_text: Yes, by Ochsner's own account: an unauthorized party accessed two employee accounts on Sept 18 to 21 and downloaded files from one. How, by whom and how many people are affected are not established.
label: Confirmed
what_would_settle_it: Ochsner's forensic findings on how the accounts were accessed, or a regulator filing or independent report.

question_text: Is the Vortex group responsible for the Ochsner breach?
answer_text: Not established. Vortex claims about 25,000 files from Ochsner's Microsoft 365 system. Ochsner has not tied the group to its incident and no outlet has verified the claim.
label: Not established
what_would_settle_it: Ochsner, a regulator or independent forensic work naming an actor.

question_text: Was Ochsner patient care or MyChart disrupted?
answer_text: No, according to Ochsner. It says there was no disruption to patient care, its Epic record system, MyOchsner/MyChart or any other system. We found no report saying otherwise.
label: Debunked

question_text: What information may have been taken?
answer_text: Ochsner says it may include names, demographic information, Social Security numbers and health information, and varies by person. It has not said which people or how many.
label: Confirmed

question_text: What should I do if I get a letter from Ochsner?
answer_text: Ochsner says letters are coming, with one year of free credit monitoring if your Social Security number was involved. Use the contact details on Ochsner's notice. Be wary of calls or emails about it asking for payment or logins.
label: Confirmed

question_text: Have security researchers tied Vortex to the Ochsner breach?
answer_text: No. Unit 42 published research on Nov 20 about an extortion cluster it calls Vortex that targets healthcare through fake IT-support calls. It does not name Ochsner, and Ochsner has not said how its accounts were accessed or who did it.
label: Not established
what_would_settle_it: Ochsner, a regulator or an independent forensic report naming the attacker or the method.
